items.question: How much can I claim per night for a hotel on a business trip to Shanghai?
items.reference_answer: Shanghai is a tier-1 city, so lodging is capped at 650 yuan per night.
evidence: up to 650 yuan per night in tier-1 cities (Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou, Shenzhen)

items.question: Until when can I use annual leave I didn't take this year?
items.reference_answer: It can be carried over until March 31 of the following year, after which it expires.
evidence: Unused annual leave can be carried over until March 31 of the following year, after which it expires

items.question: How many days a month can employees on probation work remotely?
evidence: Employees on probation may work remotely up to 2 days a month

items.question: How big is the yearly learning fund?
items.reference_answer: Each employee has 3,000 yuan per year for books, online courses or tech conferences.
evidence: Each employee has a learning fund of 3,000 yuan per year

items.question: Who has to approve a single expense claim over 5,000 yuan?
items.reference_answer: Both the department head and the finance director.
evidence: A single claim over 5,000 yuan needs approval from both the department head and the finance director

items.question: Roughly how many months' salary is the year-end bonus for an employee rated A?
items.reference_answer: The baseline is 2 months' salary and the A factor is 1.3, so about 2.6 months' salary.

items.question: What should I do if I suspect a data leak?
items.reference_answer: Report it to the security team within 1 hour via security@xinghe.example or extension 8110.
evidence: Suspected data leaks must be reported to the security team within 1 hour via security@xinghe.example or internal extension 8110

items.question: When and where does the morning shuttle leave?
items.reference_answer: At 8:30 and 9:00 from Exit B of Binhe Road subway station.
evidence: shuttles leave from Exit B of Binhe Road subway station at 8:30 and 9:00

items.question: Do new employees get a mentor, and how often do they meet?
items.reference_answer: Yes, a "navigator" mentor, with at least one one-on-one per week during the first three months.
evidence: New employees are assigned a "navigator" (mentor) and have at least one one-on-one per week during their first three months
